description: Ministry of Water Supply - Constructions of the access road to Kurunduwaththa Water Tower and Laying of pipe line under stage III of Greater Galle water Supply, Intake and Pump house of Ruwanwella Water Supply, Pump house No. 22 under Unawatuna Waste Water Management Projects and Errata Notice to the Ex.Gaz.No. 2063/26 of 21.03.2018
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. It specifically describes the approval of acquiring servitude rights and immobile properties for various water supply projects, including detailed descriptions of land parcels, their boundaries, locations, and claimants. While a minister is named (Vasudeva Nanayakkara), this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose, and no detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities are described. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registrations, acquisitions, and property descriptions.
